description: Qualitative check of one business process against the process-selection criteria of the Primessio AI Implementation Framework (volume and repeatability, data availability, measurability, risk of errors). Returns which criteria are met and a suggested next step. No scores, prices or promises. Do not pass personal data.

data.description: Is the data the AI would work on available and reasonably clean?

error_impact.description: How serious is an AI mistake in this process?

lang.description: Language of the content: pl (Polish), de (German), en (English).

measurable.description: Can the result be checked and compared with today?

process.description: Short description of the process, e.g. "answering customer e-mails about order status".

volume.description: How often the task repeats per month.

name: assess_ai_readiness
title: Check if a process is a good first AI candidate
